text: …　こんな　ポケモン　では　ダメか

structure.jp: …　こんな　ポケモン　では

patterns.name: 〜ではだめだ
patterns.span: ポケモン　では　ダメ
patterns.explanation: では before ダメ says that using this thing is not good enough. こんな　ポケモン　では　ダメ = 'Pokémon like these won't do'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realization)
patterns.explanation: か at the end, said to yourself, shows you have just come to accept something. ダメか = 'so it's no good, huh'.
